Can you help me structure the major milestones and break them down into manageable tasks, making sure we don't have any tasks that are too complex to execute?

### Milestone roadmap (sequenced by dependencies)

| # | Milestone | Tasks | Hours | Depends on |
|---|-----------|-------|-------|------------|
| M1 | Project Setup & Architecture | 4 | 20 | — |

| M5 | Visualization & Dashboard UI | 6 | 42 | M4 |

M2 and M3 can run **in parallel** after M1 — that's your main schedule compression opportunity.

### Task breakdown

**M1 — Setup & Architecture (20h)**
- Define architecture & technology stack (6h)
- Design data schemas & models (6h)
- Scaffold repository & CI skeleton (4h)
- Set up local dev environment (4h)

**M2 — Customer CSV Ingestion (34h)**

- Build cleaning & normalization transforms (8h)
- Implement load into analytics store (6h)
- Handle schema drift & malformed rows (8h)

**M3 — Log Analysis (34h)**
- Build log ingestion, file & stream (6h)
- Implement log parser for structured fields (8h)
- Error classification & severity tagging (6h)
- Anomaly detection rules (8h)
- Emit log-derived metrics (6h)

**M4 — Metrics & Aggregation API (30h)**
- Define metric catalog (4h)
- Implement aggregation queries (8h)
- Build REST API endpoints (8h)
- Add caching layer (6h)
- API documentation & contract tests (4h)

**M5 — Visualization & Dashboard UI (42h)**
- Dashboard shell & routing (6h)
- Reusable chart component library (8h)
- Customer analytics views (8h)
- Log & error analytics views (8h)
- Filters & global date range (6h)
- Responsive layout & accessibility pass (6h)

**M6 — Quality Assurance & Release (44h)**
- Unit & integration test suites (8h)
- End-to-end tests (8h)
- Performance benchmarking & tuning (8h)
- Security review (6h)
- CI/CD pipeline (6h)
- Production deployment & monitoring (8h)

### Complexity check ✅
Every one of the 31 executable tasks is **complexity ≤ 4/10 and ≤ 8 hours** — no task exceeds a single working day. Average complexity across the project is 3.5/10.

One note on the audit: the analyzer still flags **M6** at 6/10, but that's a keyword heuristic reacting to its description ("test suites, performance benchmarks, security review, CI/CD pipeline"). M6 is an epic container, not a work item — its six children are all 6–8h and complexity ≤4. I deliberately left the description intact rather than stripping useful scope detail to satisfy the heuristic.

### Recommended starting point
**"Define architecture & technology stack"** and **"Design data schemas & models"** (both 6h, complexity 3) — they're the highest-scoring ready tasks and unblock everything downstream. I'd run them together, since the schema design depends on the stack decision.
